name: xce-mcp
instructions: Tools that read and edit the project open in the XMUER Coding Engine desktop app. Start the app and open a project first. If a call says the editor is not connected, ask the user to open the app rather than retrying in a loop. The editor's reference documents (skills) are exposed as prompts: list them when the user asks about the editor, this team, or the sites around it, and load the matching one instead of guessing.
